notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf022:l004: The word read жак is faint; translation follows the apparent idiom.

notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf022:l012: The opening word is a best visual reading; the line is faint.

notes.sayakbay-ms-current146:pdf022:l016: Both nouns are legible approximations, but the phrase's referent and metaphor are unresolved.
